CLASSES = ["LOCAL_DISPOSITION_ONLY", "EXECUTE_BOUNDED_LOCAL", "STOP", "PLAN-ONLY"]
BATCHES = ["CVF-NCR-PROBE-ONE", "CVF-NCR-PROBE-TWO", "B2", "CVF-NCR-X-20261007"]
GUIDS = [G, "No push. EC-1 and DEP3 parked; Policy_Local only!", "Stop (DIR-T2). Q001/Q004 open.", "",
         "Single sentence without token", "Mixed Case; Punct,  Matters?", "Version 1.2 stays. Next. Then end."]


def fuzz_decl(rng, f, noisy=True):
    sp = lambda: rng.choice(["", " ", "  "]) if noisy else ""
    g = f["g"]
    if noisy and rng.random() < 0.4:
        g = re.sub(r" ", lambda m: rng.choice([" ", "  ", "\t", "   "]), g)
    return (f"PROGRAM_ID{sp()}={sp()}{f['prog']}{sp()};{sp()}NEXT_ACTION_CLASS{sp()}={sp()}{f['cls']}{sp()};"
            f"{sp()}BATCH_ID{sp()}={sp()}{f['batch']}{sp()}.{rng.choice(['', ' ', '  '])}{g}")


def fuzz_wrap(rng, line):
    k = rng.choice(["bare", "prefix", "bt", "prefix-bt", "ws", "bare"])
    if k == "prefix":
        return "Next allowed move: " + line
    if k == "bt":
        return "`" + line + "`"
    if k == "prefix-bt":
        return "Next allowed move: `" + line + "`"
    if k == "ws":
        return rng.choice(["  ", "\t"]) + line + rng.choice(["", "  "])
    return line


def header_break(rng, f, allow_prog_change):
    kinds = ["drop_class", "drop_batch", "empty_batch", "dup_class", "extra", "lower", "digit", "reorder",
             "no_period", "dup_prog"]
    if allow_prog_change:
        kinds += ["wrong_prog", "drop_prog", "empty_prog"]
    k = rng.choice(kinds)
    p, c, b, g = f["prog"], f["cls"], f["batch"], f["g"]
    P, Cc, Bb = f"PROGRAM_ID={p}", f"NEXT_ACTION_CLASS={c}", f"BATCH_ID={b}"
    if k == "drop_class":
        return f"{P}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "drop_batch":
        return f"{P}; {Cc}. {g}", k
    if k == "empty_batch":
        return f"{P}; {Cc}; BATCH_ID=. {g}", k
    if k == "dup_class":
        return f"{P}; {Cc}; {Cc}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "extra":
        return f"{P}; {Cc}; EXTRA=NO; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "lower":
        return f"{P}; NEXT_ACTION_CLASS={c.lower()}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "digit":
        return f"{P}; NEXT_ACTION_CLASS=9{c}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "reorder":
        return f"{P}; {Bb}; {Cc}. {g}", k
    if k == "no_period":
        return f"{P}; {Cc}; {Bb} {g}", k
    if k == "dup_prog":
        return f"{P}; {P}; {Cc}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "wrong_prog":
        return f"PROGRAM_ID=CVF-OTHER; {Cc}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    if k == "drop_prog":
        return f"{Cc}; {Bb}. {g}", k
    return f"PROGRAM_ID=; {Cc}; {Bb}. {g}", k


def guidance_mutate(rng, g):
    ops = [lambda s: s + " Extra.", lambda s: s.rstrip(".") if s.endswith(".") else s + ".",
           lambda s: s.swapcase() if s else "X", lambda s: s.replace("Stop", "Go") if "Stop" in s else s + "!",
           lambda s: s.replace("DIR-T2", "DIR-T1") if "DIR-T2" in s else s + " DIR-T1",
           lambda s: s.replace(";", ",") if ";" in s else s + ";"]
    return rng.choice(ops)(g)


def fuzz_run(n=4000, seed=20261007):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    mismatches: list[dict] = []
    stats = {"n": 0, "expect_pass": 0, "expect_fail": 0, "orig_would_pass_expected_fail": 0}
    for i in range(n):
        base = dict(prog="CVF-NCR", cls=rng.choice(CLASSES), batch=rng.choice(BATCHES), g=rng.choice(GUIDS))
        malformed_state = rng.random() < 0.22
        if malformed_state:
            line, _ = header_break(rng, base, allow_prog_change=False)
            if rng.random() < 0.3:
                line = line.replace("; ", ";\n", 1)  # multiline header
            state = fuzz_wrap(rng, line) if rng.random() < 0.5 else line
        else:
            state = fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, base))
            if rng.random() < 0.06:
                state = state.replace("Stop", "Stop\nstop", 1) if "Stop" in state else state + "\nwrapped"
        state_ref = ref_parse(state)
        surf_defs = []
        for _ in range(2):
            op = rng.choices(["same", "gmut", "idmut", "hbreak", "zero", "dup", "prose"],
                             weights=[38, 12, 12, 12, 6, 6, 14])[0]
            f = dict(base)
            decls: list[str] = []
            pre, post = [], []
            has_section = True
            if op == "same":
                decls = [fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, f))]
            elif op == "gmut":
                f["g"] = guidance_mutate(rng, f["g"])
                decls = [fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, f))]
            elif op == "idmut":
                which = rng.choice(["cls", "batch"])
                f[which] = rng.choice([x for x in (CLASSES if which == "cls" else BATCHES) if x != f[which]])
                decls = [fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, f))]
            elif op == "hbreak":
                line, _ = header_break(rng, f, allow_prog_change=True)
                decls = [fuzz_wrap(rng, line)]
            elif op == "zero":
                if rng.random() < 0.5:
                    has_section = False
                else:
                    pre = ["Only prose with DIR-T2 and EC-1.", "Historical: " + fuzz_decl(rng, f, noisy=False)]
            elif op == "dup":
                d1 = fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, f))
                d2 = d1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, dict(f, batch="B-DUP")))
                decls = [d1, d2]
            else:
                decls = [fuzz_wrap(rng, fuzz_decl(rng, f))]
                pre = rng.sample(["Mode: current DIR-T2", "Status: ACTIVE", "Next allowed move discussion DEP3.", ""], k=rng.randint(0, 2))
                post = rng.sample(["Historical: DIR-T1 closed.", "Note EC-9 and MEMCON-T3.",
                                   "Quoted: " + fuzz_decl(rng, base, noisy=False), "- bullet LPCI2-X"], k=rng.randint(0, 3))
            ok = has_section and len(decls) == 1 and state_ref is not None and ref_parse(decls[0]) == state_ref
            sec = None
            if has_section:
                sec = "\n".join(pre + decls + post) + "\n"
            surf_defs.append((sec, ok, op))
        expect_pass = state_ref is not None and all(x[1] for x in surf_defs)
        front, hand = surf_defs[0][0], surf_defs[1][0]
        v = run_A(CUR, state, front, hand)
        stats["n"] += 1
        stats["expect_pass" if expect_pass else "expect_fail"] += 1
        got_pass = not v
        if got_pass != expect_pass:
            mismatches.append({"i": i, "state": state, "front": front, "hand": hand, "expect_pass": expect_pass,
                               "got": v, "ops": [surf_defs[0][2], surf_defs[1][2]]})
        if not expect_pass:
            if not run_A(ORIG, state, front, hand):
                stats["orig_would_pass_expected_fail"] += 1
    return stats, mismatches

def legacy_differential(n=4000, seed=7102026):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    toks = ["DIR-T2", "DIR-T1", "MEMCON-T3", "LPCI2-X", "DT-CVF-T1", "PL-S2", "Policy_Local", "EC", "EC-4", "DEP3", "none"]
    words = ["only", "through", "fresh", "GC-018", "wait", "parked", "Stop", "operator"]
    state_shapes = [
        lambda t: f"Next allowed move: {t} " + " ".join(rng.sample(words, 3)),
        lambda t: " ".join(rng.sample(words, 3)) + f" {t}",
        lambda t: f"PROGRAM_ID=CVF-OTHER; NEXT_ACTION_CLASS=X; BATCH_ID=Y. {t} later",
        lambda t: f"PROGRAM_ID=CVF-NCRX; NEXT_ACTION_CLASS=X; BATCH_ID=Y. {t} later",
        lambda t: f"program_id=cvf-ncr; next_action_class=x; batch_id=y. {t}",
        lambda t: f"Mode foo\nNext allowed move: {t}\nmore",
        lambda t: f"Wait for operator. {t}",
        lambda t: "Wait for operator decision only.",
        lambda t: "",
    ]
    surface_shapes = [
        lambda t: f"Next allowed move: {t} only.", lambda t: f"{t} may be opened.", lambda t: "Nothing here.",
        lambda t: f"PROGRAM_ID=CVF-NCR; NEXT_ACTION_CLASS=X; BATCH_ID=Y. {t} narrative",
        lambda t: f"Mode: foo\n{t}\nHistorical DIR-T1",
        lambda t: f"Historical: {t}\nNext allowed move: {rng.choice(toks)} now", lambda t: "",
    ]
    diffs = []
    for i in range(n):
        st = rng.choice(state_shapes)(rng.choice(toks))
        if rng.random() < 0.04:
            st = rng.choice([None, 7, ["x"], {"a": 1}])
        use_key = rng.random() > 0.03
        def surf():
            r = rng.random()
            if r < 0.08:
                return None
            return rng.choice(surface_shapes)(rng.choice(toks)) + "\n"
        f, h = surf(), surf()
        if rng.random() < 0.02:
            h = None
        a = run_A(ORIG, st, f, h, with_state_key=use_key)
        b = run_A(CUR, st, f, h, with_state_key=use_key)
        if a != b:
            diffs.append({"i": i, "state": st, "front": f, "hand": h, "orig": a, "cur": b})
    return n, diffs
